svg.aria-label: I'm an undergrad at BITS Pilani trying to figure out how AI systems fail when someone is actually trying to break them: how they fail, why they fail, and whether they deserve the trust people put in them. Benchmarks only tell part of that story, so I go looking for the rest. I implement backdoor attacks, poke around inside models with mechanistic interpretability, and audit AI systems and web services that are already out in the real world. Alongside that, I work at a startup building production voice agents and pipelines. Next, I want to point the same lens at them: where voice pipelines break, and what it takes to make them safe. Right now: Researching: AI trust signals, and whether they survive audits; Building: real-time voice agents and pipelines at a startup; Open to: research internships · predoc · AI safety fellowships
